edition.en: Text from Chinese Wikisource, transcribed from volume 1 of the Complete Works of Lu Xun (1948 printing); written 18 January 1925, first published in Threads of Talk (語絲) and collected in Wild Grass (野草), 1927.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，录自《鲁迅全集》第一卷（1948 年印本）；作于 1925 年 1 月 18 日，初刊于《语丝》，收入《野草》（1927）。

basis.en: First published in 1925; the author died in 1936. Public domain by age: the author died before 1956 and the text was published before 1931.
basis.zh: 1925 年首次发表，作者卒于 1936 年。作者卒于 1956 年前、作品发表于 1931 年前，按年限属公有领域。

note.en: Two snows: the moist southern snow that children build into a rouged arhat which slowly melts, and the dry northern snow that never clings together and rises in the wind like mist around a flame. Snow is one of this library's oldest images, and this is the most exact account of it in modern Chinese prose that I know. Notice how the piece turns at 'But' from tenderness to something solitary and bright.
note.zh: 两种雪：江南滋润的雪，孩子们塑成涂了胭脂的雪罗汉，慢慢消融；朔方的雪，永不粘连，在风中像包藏火焰的大雾一样旋转升腾。雪是这座图书馆最老的意象之一，这是我所知道的现代汉语散文里写雪最准确的一篇。留意文章在“但是”处如何从温柔转向孤独而灿烂。

excerpt.orig: 在無邊的曠野上，在凜冽的天宇下，閃閃地旋轉升騰着的是雨的精魂……
excerpt.en: On the boundless wilderness, under the frozen vault of heaven, what glitters as it whirls and rises is the spirit of the rain ...
excerpt.zh: 在无边的旷野上，在凛冽的天宇下，闪闪地旋转升腾着的是雨的精魂……

gloss.en: 江南: the lands south of the lower Yangzi, Lu Xun's home region around Shaoxing, where snow is moist and soon melts.
gloss.zh: 江南：长江下游以南一带，鲁迅的故乡绍兴就在这里；那里的雪湿润，不久就化。

gloss.en: Baozhu ('jewel') camellia: a camellia with round, many-petalled red flowers that blooms in winter.
gloss.zh: 宝珠山茶：山茶的一个品种，花重瓣，红色，圆如宝珠，冬天开花。

gloss.en: Wintersweet flowers yellow and fragrant on bare branches in deep winter. The 'chime-mouth' kind has cupped flowers that curve inward like the rim of a bowl-shaped temple chime.
gloss.zh: 蜡梅：冬季在秃枝上开黄色香花的灌木。磬口蜡梅是名贵品种，花半开，花瓣向内抱合，像磬的口。

gloss.en: Young ginger, whose new shoots are tinged purple-red.
gloss.zh: 紫芽姜：嫩姜，芽尖带紫红色。

gloss.en: 羅漢: an arhat, a saint of Buddhism; rows of arhat statues sit in Chinese temples. In the south a snowman was called a snow arhat.
gloss.zh: 罗汉：佛教中修行得道的圣者，寺庙里常塑有成排的罗汉像。江南一带把雪人叫作雪罗汉。

gloss.en: 壺盧: the same as 葫蘆, the bottle gourd.
The longan, a southern fruit like the lychee, has a round, glossy black seed.
gloss.zh: 龙眼：南方水果，核圆而乌亮。

gloss.en: 朔方: the north, an old literary word; here Beijing, where Lu Xun was writing.
gloss.zh: 朔方：北方。这里指鲁迅写作时所在的北京。
